HomePage.heading: Find the universities that actually fit you.
HomePage.description: Project scaffolding is in place: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, the Unifind design tokens, an anonymous session for every visitor, and full English/Ukrainian support. No account needed — the matching engine, real screens, and catalog browsing come in the next stages.
HomePage.quickMatchFieldLabel: What do you want to study?
HomePage.howItWorksStep1Description: Tell us your academic background, budget constraints, and personal preferences.
HomePage.howItWorksStep2Description: Our algorithm scores programmes based on how well they align with your unique needs.
HomePage.howItWorksStep3Description: Compare top choices, check requirements, and confidently begin your application process.
